title: Dr Fred's Scotch Bonnet

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Didn’t think you’d dare show your face around here again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Didn’t think you’d dare show your face around here again.
Do you have an appointment?
What?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Oh, yes. Thank CORA, give it here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, yes. Thank CORA, give it here.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: No time to eat, so the more stuff I can get in a coffee, the better. Don’t suppose you brought my ramen order too? That way I can just pour the coffee into the noodles.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No time to eat, so the more stuff I can get in a coffee, the better. Don’t suppose you brought my ramen order too? That way I can just pour the coffee into the noodles.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Thanks. And now I have to get back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks. And now I have to get back.
If I don't, who will?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Those drugs you gave me were bad. Cut with CORA knows what. I lost two patients.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Those drugs you gave me were bad. Cut with CORA knows what. I lost two patients.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: If you'd got them from a reputable source, it wouldn't have happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you'd got them from a reputable source, it wouldn't have happened.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Well, you didn't. So say what you want and get out of my sight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, you didn't. So say what you want and get out of my sight.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: You think that makes things better?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You think that makes things better?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Whatever. Just give it to me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Whatever. Just give it to me?

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: If I wasn't a doctor, I would break your nose. Now get away from me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If I wasn't a doctor, I would break your nose. Now get away from me.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: I'm not taking anything from you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not taking anything from you.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: No... Please say you didn't bring the wrong thing. I don't have the energy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... Please say you didn't bring the wrong thing. I don't have the energy.
Thanks. Now get lost.

nodes.speaker: Dr Fred Matombo
nodes.text: Why are you such a jerk? That's not my coffee!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you such a jerk? That's not my coffee!
No, I have your coffee.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Strawberry gateaux choc bomb with toffee whip and scotch bonnet float?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It sounds pretty sweet.
Eww.
That's kind of genius.
Don't work too hard.
What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You asked for the drugs, I got them. I did my part.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You asked for the drugs, I got them. I did my part.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You asked for the drugs, I got them. I did my part.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You asked for the drugs, I got them. I did my part.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sorry, I didn't know.
I thought I was helping.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I have a coffee for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have a coffee for you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I have a coffee for you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I have a coffee for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No... It's your order from Coffee PoccoCup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No... It's your order from Coffee PoccoCup.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No... It's your order from Coffee PoccoCup.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No... It's your order from Coffee PoccoCup.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But I have your coffee...
Gladly.
Lithium Latte?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine, one Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, one Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fine, one Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fine, one Strawberry Gateaux Choc Bomb.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine, here's your Lithium Latte.
